'''West Reyno River''' was a river on [[Brosi]], to the west of [[Reyno Valley]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

West Reyno Valley was in the influence area of the [[Brosin Underground]] around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />
